ds:284:234:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I was just giving him a ride a second ago! He’s at the lake.

ds:284:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Okay! Dustin should be around here somewhere. Maybe check on the south shore!

ds:285:198:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:285:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I don’t really know folks too much yet, so I’m probably not the one to ask…

ds:286:202:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:286:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh sure! Bucky has been looking for one for a while now.

ds:286:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]He’s just South of here. We just finished a cup of tea together.

ds:287:206:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:287:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]However, I could use a haircut… heh.

ds:288:211:Dialogue Text.source: Know anyone looking for a shovel?

ds:288:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooooh yeah! That’s us! We need a shovel!

ds:288:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Nope. Sorry Rascal, we can’t help you.

ds:289:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Wow! This sounds like a ton of work! Let me know if I can help!

ds:289:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Quite ambitious! I’d be happy to lend a paw too!

ds:289:203:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Thanks mates! But putting it together is part of the training!

ds:289:204:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Though perhaps havin’ ya clear out some trees wouldn’t be a bad idea…

ds:289:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s curious we haven’t found more shovels…

ds:289:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’ll let Peter know to keep an eye out next time he’s out.

ds:289:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]If I’m out training, I’ll be sure to keep an eye out too!

ds:289:218:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I got the OK a bit ago from Scarlett here, but just got crackin’ on it.

ds:289:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And sorry if we put you on the spot!

ds:289:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ll be able to do extensive workout routines! With proper flat ground and no potential hazards to worry about!

ds:289:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Could even run a course for ya guys, if ya’d like!

ds:289:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Whattya say? Wanna sweat and lose some pounds?

ds:289:227:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ll be honest dear, I don’t think I could keep up!

ds:289:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah, sorry sonny! I’m a bit past my prime for that sorta thing!

ds:289:235:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I should be able to make a few courses of varying intensities, so everyone can have a go!

ds:289:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But that’s a bit away… First thing’s first! Gotta make it!

ds:289:238:Dialogue Text.source: Oh right! I’ve got a Shovel!

ds:289:240:Dialogue Text.source: Yeaaah, I’m not sure if that’s my thing…

ds:289:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oy come on now, I bet ya’ve been rollin’ about all day, huh?

ds:289:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I can teach ya some more secrets if ya come train!

ds:289:244:Dialogue Text.source: Errr, but it’s a shop order. From Maverick.

ds:289:246:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! I ordered one a bit ago!

ds:289:255:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I needed one to tend to the garden. I was out here grabbing some herbs I’d like to grow at home.

ds:289:256:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Lots of general spices that’s handy for all of the critters…

ds:289:258:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]And I’ve got a new project underway…

ds:289:259:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I need to dig up a bunch of clay, and I’m basically stuck until I get a shovel…

ds:289:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And I need it for the training grounds…

ds:289:265:Dialogue Text.source: I think Scarlett should have it.

ds:289:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I’ll be as quick as I can! Then I can pass it along!

ds:289:270:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sounds good, I can help with the garden if ya’d like!

ds:289:271:Dialogue Text.source: I think Bucky should have it.

ds:289:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ya sure? I don’t mean to step on any toes…

ds:289:275:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Nonsense! Where would be without your help!

ds:289:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]You can do what you need to, then pass it along.

ds:289:277:Dialogue Text.source: I think Dustin should have it.

ds:289:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Yeah? I’ll be quick with it! Then I can pass it along!

ds:289:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m quite excited to see your project come along.

ds:289:285:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Hmmm, well, there’s not too much of a rush on my end.

ds:289:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]The season just started after all, plenty of time for things to grow!

ds:289:288:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And, I wouldn’t mind a good excuse to take a break!

ds:289:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Works for me! I could use a breather after hulling all this junk!

ds:289:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Works for me! I could use a breather after hauling all this junk!

ds:289:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m excited to see it too! Always happy to see more craftsman critters!

ds:289:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Let me know if you need any help!

ds:289:296:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]My back is a bit sore after fixing up that bridge…

ds:289:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Appreciate it mates! There’s heaps to do, so this’ll will help a lot!

ds:289:302:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]After I’m done, I’ll pass it along!

ds:28:20:Dialogue Text.source: But at least it’s a nice day.

ds:290:199:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Did you figure out who the shovel was for?

ds:290:200:Dialogue Text.source: Sort of… a few critters needed it…

ds:290:201:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh no. I messed that up big time.

ds:290:202:Dialogue Text.source: But it’s ok! We figured it out.

ds:290:206:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Damn, you really saved my rump this time!

ds:290:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]If the customer is happy, I’m happy!

ds:290:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And it’s all thanks to you, Red!

ds:290:209:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Now it’s time to show my thanks!

ds:290:210:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I’m a business man through and through, so your time will be compensated, absolutely.

ds:290:211:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Given how long this took you, how many tasks you completed, your expertise in the field…

ds:290:214:Dialogue Text.source: Sounds a little low there, bud…

ds:290:216:Dialogue Text.source: RECEIVE 7 or 10 COINS (this doesn’t really matter)
ds:290:216:Dialogue Text.target: RECEIVE 7 or 10 COINS (this doesn’t really matter)

ds:290:217:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now that that’s all taken care of, welcome to my shop!

ds:290:218:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Thanks to you, I’ve had the time to reorganize and set this baby up!

ds:290:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]And now that you have some cash, we can talk business!

ds:290:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Let me know if anything catches your interest!

ds:290:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh and, if you just want to hang out, I’ll be here!

ds:290:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I may be running a business, but we’re still buds, Red!

ds:290:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]What! Are you honestly hard balling me here, Red?

ds:290:225:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I suppose you did save my butt.

ds:292:278:Dialogue Text.source: More importantly, squeeze that bad boy in there.

ds:293:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]A lil, welcome gift and personal favorite of mine!

ds:293:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This lil’ baby has helped me get an eye for spotting out various interesting things!

ds:293:138:Dialogue Text.source: Wait, do you need this to see?

ds:293:140:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]See I’ve got a fancy pair of specs now. I haven’t used that lil guy in years.

ds:293:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But it served me well, so take care of it!

ds:294:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Ah, you’d like to hear more about Lanora, eh?

ds:294:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Fortunately, I do have another passage I can share!

ds:294:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]As previously discussed, there were many group-oriented events, involving critters of all shapes and sizes.

ds:294:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]This passage reveals that there were also smaller, private events. Likely for the most devout? A right of passage, perhaps?

ds:294:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, from what I gather, Lanora would occasionally choose two disciples, often male.

ds:294:163:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They’d escort her across the forest, through the darkest of woods, all the way to the top of a mountain. There they would find a hidden cave.

ds:294:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Once in the cave, the disciples and Lanora would engage in a union of the body.

ds:294:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That is to say, they got… uh… Down and dirty…

ds:294:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]This particular scripture goes on and on.

ds:294:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Like half of the glyphs are about how they switch sides, fill her holes, bathe her in their… *ahem* well, you know…

ds:294:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Honestly, I can’t imagine what sort of worship this was…

ds:294:174:Dialogue Text.source: Are you sure this was a form of worship?

ds:294:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well certainly! These inscriptions are rare, you see. Especially for their time.

ds:294:176:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Writing and record-keeping was a niche task. Only certain learned critters were scribes. So typically, only important events were written down.

ds:294:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Still, quite a saucy ritual… I can’t quite connect the dots…

ds:294:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]… But this Forest was indeed full of “love” before.

ds:294:180:Dialogue Text.source: What else do you know about the “Shrine Maiden”?

ds:295:170:Dialogue Text.source: They shared Lanora, body and soul.

ds:295:171:Dialogue Text.source: One would take her from the front, and the other would take her from the back.

ds:295:172:Dialogue Text.source: Long into the night, the disciples would spend hours trying to sate Lanora.

ds:295:173:Dialogue Text.source: It’s said her lust and scent invigorated the males. Tapping into their primal natures…

ds:296:142:Dialogue Text.source: I just finished fooling around with some friends, right?

ds:296:143:Dialogue Text.source: We were cuddling together, catching our breath and enjoying the shade, y’know?

ds:296:144:Dialogue Text.source: Well across from me, I spot her…

ds:296:145:Dialogue Text.source: She’s a bit shorter than you, super cute hat, rockin’ bod…

ds:296:146:Dialogue Text.source: She was ridin’ this guy, giving me quite the show!

ds:296:147:Dialogue Text.source: I thought it was just a coincidence, and then we locked eyes.

ds:296:148:Dialogue Text.source: She lifted her tail to give me the full show! I was hard again in seconds!

ds:297:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]A partner? Naw, this is a pretty solo venture.

ds:297:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Why do you ask Red, you want in as a business partner?

ds:297:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I might be able to cut you in… but we wouldn’t be look at anything more than 7 percent…

ds:297:139:Dialogue Text.source:
No, I meant a
relationship partner.

ds:297:142:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Naw, I don’t really have time for that sorta thing…

ds:297:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]She was absolutely inviting me to join… but uh…

ds:297:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]For some reason… I couldn’t accept it…

ds:297:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I dunno Red… There was something different about her…

ds:297:157:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I just got kinda scared that… maybe that was a path I wasn’t ready for…

ds:297:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Well I just don’t have time for something serious, y’know?

ds:297:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s a lot of work running a business.

ds:297:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]So it’s hard to imagine squeezing in a relationship…

ds:297:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But, that’s not to say I don’t sleep around!

ds:297:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Heh, there’s a nice lil lagoon down the river.

ds:297:165:Dialogue Text.source:
Well maybe she didn’t want
anything serious.

ds:297:169:Dialogue Text.source:
You should!
She seems interested, and
it might be a fun opportunity.

ds:297:170:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s a common place to go for a quick hook up!

ds:297:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Red, I ain’t gonna sugar coat it, it’s basically a non-stop orgy.

ds:297:173:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yep! I used to spend a lot of time there! Buncha party animals!

ds:297:174:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Not quite my speed these days… but I meet up with some old friends and fool around here ’n there.

ds:297:175:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I should really take ya down there sometime!

ds:297:177:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Y’know… There is this one girl at the lagoon…

ds:297:178:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmm! Y’know after hearing it aloud, it seems so obvious.

ds:297:179:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I could always let her know what I’m looking for, I’m sure she’d understand!

ds:297:182:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Part of me thinks I actually WANT to be serious with her…

ds:297:184:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m serious Red! This is kinda why I was avoiding it… I don’t wanna mess it up…

ds:297:185:Dialogue Text.source:
Mmm, I think you should talk to her.
You wouldn’t want to miss
this experience entirely, right?

ds:297:188:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Some flirty smiles and gestures here ’n there, but the last time I saw her…

ds:297:190:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m usually pretty surface level when fooling with the critters there.

ds:297:195:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]I think you’re right, Red! I’ll talk to her!

ds:297:197:Dialogue Text.source:
And thank you
for the saucy story!

ds:297:198:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s a lil’ spicy though, so be prepared!

ds:298:288:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah I’ll say! Ya practically jumped on me!

ds:298:289:Dialogue Text.source: Gus’ might be a gentle giant, but ohgosh, when all that weight is on top of you…

ds:298:291:Dialogue Text.source: H-hey… I know I’ve put on a few pounds…

ds:298:293:Dialogue Text.source: No no, I didn’t mean it that way!

ds:298:294:Dialogue Text.source: You’re just a lot bigger than me, and uh, heh… It’s super hot.

ds:298:317:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh I see. Well, I’m glad you enjoyed it!

ds:298:318:Dialogue Text.source: I uh… really enjoyed it too…

ds:298:320:Dialogue Text.source: I’d say! I’ve never seen you cum so much…

ds:298:333:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, well you see, I too prepped for our meet…

ds:298:337:Dialogue Text.source: You’re getting better at that, aren’t you?

ds:298:351:Dialogue Text.source: All the better for what happened next…

ds:298:355:Dialogue Text.source: See Rascal, once Gus has his fun, he insists on cleaning his own mess!

ds:298:372:Dialogue Text.source: Heh, I mean… I couldn’t leave you like that…

ds:298:375:Dialogue Text.source: Gosh, and that tongue gets EVERYWHERE!

ds:298:390:Dialogue Text.source: And uh… I swear you were suckin’ on my paws a bit…

ds:298:391:Dialogue Text.source: Is that a new thing for you?

ds:298:393:Dialogue Text.source: What can I say? I missed those lil’ beans…

ds:299:377:Dialogue Text.source:
Evening gentlemen!
Out for another round?

ds:299:381:Dialogue Text.source: Post Coital drinking? Is that a thing?

ds:299:394:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ahh, I had a really good time!

ds:299:398:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I feel like we should be thanking you Rascal…

ds:299:402:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Imagine just pickin’ up and moving… I don’t think I could do it!

ds:299:404:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]My path was pretty similar… Though I was fueled by the research first and foremost.

ds:299:405:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I also intended on returning to my home at somepoint…

ds:299:406:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But the company won me over, heh!

ds:299:408:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]It’s a past time for us, that’s for sure!

ds:299:409:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Though I didn’t have anything at my place…

ds:299:418:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’m sure Bucky and I would’ve come together at some point again…

ds:331:583:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Tell me, are you comfortable being on the receiving end?

ds:331:584:Dialogue Text.source: I am! I quite enjoy it!

ds:331:586:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not a big fan, but I’m flexible.

ds:331:588:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ll be sure to keep that in mind!

ds:331:592:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So, I actually ran into Rascal JUST AFTER it all went down.

ds:331:593:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I was gathering up my nerve to ask him out on a date - I didn’t even realize what he was up to.

ds:331:596:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Turns out he was running an errand for Scarlett. Gathering some "fresh fertilizer," stored in Scarlett’s favorite way.

ds:331:599:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Baw, I see. But still, experiencing it at all is something to respect!

ds:331:601:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So he’s over there, clenching his butt cheeks, red in the face, cum oozing down his legs - I’m over there like ’Hey uhhh wanna get a drink maybe?’

ds:331:605:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Rascal’s so humble, he didn’t cut me off, or interrupt me. Just kindly held it in, squirming.

ds:331:607:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Well now you GOTTA take him on a date. You made him suffer!

ds:331:609:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It was so funny though! If I could go back in time, I wouldn’t change a thing.

ds:331:612:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’m sorry. I’ll make it up on our date. Drinks on me!

ds:331:613:Dialogue Text.source: OK, I’ll hold you to it!

ds:331:615:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Great! I’ll move some things around and get back to you!

ds:331:616:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Till then, Penny and I were making plans to visit our little plant friend…

ds:331:618:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Mabel, hearing you call anything "little" is bizarre…

ds:331:620:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I got it from you! You’re always calling it "your little plant friend!"

ds:331:621:Dialogue Text.source: Do you see the plant often, Penny?

ds:331:624:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve been taking Mabel with me on occasion these days.

ds:331:633:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That plant really knows how to treat a lady!

ds:331:636:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]That’s true! I think just about every critter has spent ample time with that plant…

ds:331:638:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]I’ve seen Scarlett and Peter there many times. I know Oliver has expressed interest. Bucky’s fooled around a few times.

ds:331:640:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I think I’ve literally seen every critter with that plant…

ds:331:641:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]*cough* I may have uh… been in the area… Unnoticed… many times…

ds:331:642:Dialogue Text.source: Wha! Are you peeping on critters?

ds:331:644:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hey! I’m small! I can’t help if the other critters don’t notice me!

ds:331:645:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Especially in their intense throes of passion…

ds:331:649:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]So what are you two gonna do on your date?

ds:331:656:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Can’t wait to stuff my mouth! I’ll be full all night!

ds:331:657:Dialogue Text.source: Indeed! Can’t wait to "eat out" for our picnic!

ds:331:660:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Don’t be fooled Rascal! Mabel isn’t as sweet and innocent as she looks!

ds:331:661:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]She’s been known to peep about on occasions!

ds:331:664:Dialogue Text.source:
Mabel, I hereby give you permission to peep
on any and all sexual activities I’m involved in.

ds:331:668:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]You must, however, regale all events to Penny Plume. No details shall be left out!

ds:332:634:Dialogue Text.source: She was all tied up, gaping after this crazy messy pull out!

ds:332:635:Dialogue Text.source: I was right on her, so I could feel her twitching and squirming as she came.

ds:332:637:Dialogue Text.source: I’m tellin’ ya! I was being tickled!

ds:332:638:Dialogue Text.source: The plant was all slurping on my talons, you’d be giggling too!

ds:332:640:Dialogue Text.source: That’s not how I remember it!

ds:332:642:Dialogue Text.source: What about you? I seem to remember some intense shivers of pleasure when those tentacles were twisting around in ya.

ds:333:29:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hmmm yeaah. I think this place will do just fine!

ds:333:31:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oy mate! Just preparing for the dig!

ds:333:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I needed a bit more space, so I got the OK from Scarlett to do it here!

ds:333:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]You’ll see, check up on me later!

ds:334:29:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Just got some finishing touches, and we’ll be good to go!

ds:334:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Can’t wait to show ya what I got prepared for this thing!

ds:334:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Can’t wait to show ya what I got prepared for this thing!

ds:335:30:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks mate! Just wait till we get to training!

ds:335:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.

ds:335:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!

ds:335:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ehhh, I’ll need some time to recuperate. That was a ton of work.

ds:335:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But as soon as I’m ready, you’ll know!

ds:336:148:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew! Dang Rascal, I couldn’t touch you!

ds:336:149:Dialogue Text.source: I suppose I learn from the best!

ds:336:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Hah! You’re gonna be great at this! I’ll let you know when I get better routines set up!

ds:336:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hehehe… I’ve got a lot of fun stuff planned…

ds:336:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]True, but I usually hit folks a lot more than that!

ds:336:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, I got ya a few times eh?

ds:336:159:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Think you could do better next time?

ds:336:167:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Rascal, mate, I’ll be honest. That was pathetic!

ds:336:168:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, you can only go up from here, right?

ds:336:169:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let’s give it another shot when you’re ready.

ds:336:35:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I’ve got a fun lil’ routine set up.

ds:336:43:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perfect, so you should be familiar with how to move your body pretty well, yeah?

ds:336:44:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oy! Ya ready to give this a shot?

ds:336:46:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Great! For now I’ve prepared this Practice Routine. Let’s get started!

ds:336:50:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m gonna try to PELT YOU with ACORNS!

ds:336:53:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]For this first round, we’ll just see how you fare for 30 seconds!

ds:336:54:Dialogue Text.source: Uhhh, I don’t like the sound of this…

ds:336:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Psssh, don’t worry mate, it’ll be fine!

ds:336:56:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Let me know when you’re ready to get started!

ds:337:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I see, well, we just got this order in, so we’ll probably sit this one out.

ds:337:11:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s no rush!
You guys can join us.

ds:337:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It’s okay Rascal, we can’t exactly all ride Penny anyways. We’ll head over once we’re finished here.

ds:337:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Yep. Besides… that place kind of gives me the creeps…

ds:337:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ok, we’ll be sure to catch you two up then!

ds:337:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]Come quick! There’s something going on at the ruins!

ds:337:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Whoa, what do you mean? Is something wrong?

ds:337:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Augustus just told me to round up all the critters! He seemed very excited.

ds:338:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Gosh! What could all this be about?

ds:338:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Do check on the other critters… they seem a bit more worried…

ds:338:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wow check this out! The symbols are glowing!

ds:338:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No idea what this is about, but I’m pretty excited!

ds:338:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Honestly, nothing really happens here too often… So I’m a bit more excited than worried about it…

ds:338:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Besides! If anything bad happens, I can just fly away! See ya!

ds:338:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m sure nothing bad will come of this… Right?

ds:338:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]And if something bad happens… We’ll figure it out together! We’re a scrappy bunch!

ds:339:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon love, there’s no need to get worked up just yet…

ds:339:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]*Sigh* I’m sorry dear, I’m just on edge… This is very strange…

ds:339:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I know, love. But we’ll be ok…

ds:339:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh Rascal, I’m glad to see you here. Look at what’s happening!

ds:339:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]I’ve got a bad feeling about this…

ds:339:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Mmm, I don’t mean to snip dear, but I’ve been here my whole life and haven’t seen anything like this.

ds:339:9:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]If there was ever a time for concern, this is a pretty good one…

ds:33:22:Dialogue Text.source: … Yeah, definitely not going in there.

ds:340:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope we didn’t do anything wrong…

ds:340:5:Dialogue Text.source: What do you think about it?

ds:340:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]These ruins have been here for so long… and we don’t know enough about them… What if we did something wrong?

ds:341:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]What do you think it could be?? A sign? A warning?

ds:341:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I probably should be – but I’m so curious!

ds:341:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The rest of the critters say they’ve never seen this. They say it looks ominous. But I think it looks pretty!

ds:342:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…

ds:342:3:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m doing well.
What do you make of all this?

ds:342:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I’m kinda scared… But also ready.

ds:342:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, I don’t know what’s coming up, but I’m prepared to do my part. Whatever needs to be done.

ds:342:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Mate, I may be a traveler… But these critters treat me like their own. I don’t want anything bad happening to them…

ds:343:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to tell them a few times now. I’m pretty sure there’s nothin to worry about.

ds:343:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Long ago, I recall stumbling across a writing that mentioned something like this.

ds:343:12:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Though the writing didn’t mention why, or what it meant – it definitely didn’t mention any cataclysmic events afterward.

ds:343:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Perhaps this is just a temporary phenomenon. Perhaps it’s something much more…

ds:343:14:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I don’t think anything bad will come of it.

ds:343:15:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve tried to calm the critters down, but some of them can be pretty creative and get themselves worked up, heh.

ds:343:16:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I figured my time would be better spent studying this while it’s happening.

ds:343:17:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, I should get back to it!

ds:343:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It didn’t make too much sense at the time, I thought perhaps I misinterpreted it, or perhaps it was a metaphor.

ds:343:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]This is truly a sight to behold! I’ve never seen anything like this!

ds:343:6:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But there’s so much to gleam from all of this.

ds:343:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Look, even the glyphs that are broken off of the monolith are glowing.

ds:343:8:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You should see my collection back home, so many little runes glowing ever so slightly. [pic=3]When I first saw it, I thought I was going mad!

ds:343:9:Dialogue Text.source:
A lot of the critters seem worried,
do you think this is a problem?

ds:344:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Rascal, what’s all the commotion going on?

ds:344:3:Dialogue Text.source:
There’s some stuff going on in the ruins.
You might wanna check it out!

ds:344:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Ruins? I’ve never seen any ruins here… but that sounds pretty interesting…

ds:345:268:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ll have to go see for myself.

ds:345:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve heard there’s some exciting things happening? I was about to go check it out.

ds:345:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, the ruins have started glowing.
It’s pretty whacky.

ds:345:5:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Hmm, that’s quite bizarre. I’ll have to go see for myself.

ds:346:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Hey Red, I hear there’s some crazy stuff going on…

ds:346:3:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, some of the ruins are glowing…
You should check it out!

ds:346:4:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yep, just closing up the shop here first. Definitely gotta see this for myself…

ds:347:10:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Yeah, let’s make a trip out there soon…

ds:347:11:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, as I was saying – your sweater is all done!

ds:347:13:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Wait… there’s still a couple pins here…

ds:347:19:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I agree! We did quite well with this one!

ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.source: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)
ds:347:26:Dialogue Text.target: PLAYER MUST WALK AROUND FOR A FEW SECONDS (not consecutively)

ds:347:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]There he is! Good timing too, we just finished!

ds:347:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes, that’s pretty normal. This is your first time, right?

ds:347:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The fur can mingle with the cloth – but after a while it gets more comfortable

ds:347:37:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But hey, when you look this fabulous, you can’t complain!

ds:347:38:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anyways, don’t worry – You can wear it when you need to.

ds:347:3:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But uh, what was all that hubbub about?

ds:347:40:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]You won’t hurt our feelings by not wearing it.

ds:347:42:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’d prefer to see you nude anyways.

ds:347:48:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Let us know if any seams come loose.

ds:347:49:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]All of our clothes have a life time guarantee!

ds:347:4:Dialogue Text.source:
Something’s going on.
Some of the glyphs at the ruins are glowing.

ds:348:498:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah~ That was fun! We ought to do that again real soon!

ds:348:501:Dialogue Text.source:
Definitely! Hopefully I can
last longer next time…

ds:348:504:Dialogue Text.source:
I think I have a soft spot
for you smaller critters…

ds:348:506:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Magic Mabel Touch! No one can resist it!

ds:348:510:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Gotta say though, that tongue-bath was doin’ things for me.

ds:348:511:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s definitely a big button for me!

ds:348:514:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Whew! Well that was a productive day!

ds:348:515:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m going to head back and chill.

ds:348:520:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yes! We should do this again sometime!

ds:348:527:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Say big guy, you free for a bit?

ds:348:529:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We were wondering if ya wanted to take us up on that romping we mentioned earlier…

ds:348:533:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We’ve been stretching all day! Now we can put some of that to the test!

ds:348:535:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Not gonna lie, mate, always kinda wanted to have your claws riggling inside me…

ds:348:537:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That sounds great! Some good ole’ fashion finger blasting!

ds:348:538:Dialogue Text.source:
An order of finger blasting,
coming right up!

ds:348:543:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha ok you two, follow me. There’s a secluded area behind the bushes over there…

ds:349:322:Dialogue Text.source: Ok Rascal! Lay on your back over there…

ds:349:323:Dialogue Text.source: Great! Now let’s climb on top of him.

ds:349:325:Dialogue Text.source: Damn mate, already flyin’ full mast eh?

ds:349:329:Dialogue Text.source: Alright, I think we’re ready… Watch those claws!

ds:349:335:Dialogue Text.source: This is so much better than our toys Mabel!

ds:349:339:Dialogue Text.source: You two are pretty dang loose! That stretching is paying off!

ds:349:341:Dialogue Text.source: We’ve been working on depth too! I bet you can get two knuckles deep on me!

ds:349:345:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, don’t go much further for me, mate!

ds:349:346:Dialogue Text.source: You’re right up on my prostate-nnngawd it feels great!

ds:349:348:Dialogue Text.source: Hey Dustin, gimme a hand with this guy. I wanna see him squirt~!

ds:349:355:Dialogue Text.source: Mmm, that’s right mate, let it all out~

ds:349:357:Dialogue Text.source: Oooh Dustin, you got some on your face…

ds:349:361:Dialogue Text.source: Come here, I can clean you two up…

ds:34:21:Dialogue Text.source: The very fibers of your being vibrate with joy.

ds:34:23:Dialogue Text.source: It is… an extremely magnificent piece…

ds:34:25:Dialogue Text.source: Standing in the presence of this piece makes you feel complete. Nay, FULFILLED!

ds:350:37:Dialogue Text.source: This stone… It’s warm to the touch…

ds:350:38:Dialogue Text.source: You can feel an immense power flowing from within…

ds:351:20:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...

ds:351:2:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Sorry Rascal, I'm in the middle of something right now... Give me a moment...

ds:352:49:Dialogue Text.source: A bit! Those ruins were quite something!

ds:352:51:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I hope they don’t scare ya off! I’ve grown used to your company!

ds:352:52:Dialogue Text.source: Nah, I’m here for the long run.

ds:352:55:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Rascal! Good work again on the bridge! We appreciate your help!

ds:352:56:Dialogue Text.source: No problem! We make a great team!

ds:352:58:Dialogue Text.source: Let me know if you guys need anything else!

ds:353:32:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Our little town has some pretty interesting things going on huh?

ds:353:34:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ok not gonna lie, things got a lot more interesting when you arrived…

ds:353:36:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey so… When are we going on a date?

ds:353:37:Dialogue Text.source: We can go right now if you’d like!

ds:353:39:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Bah, I’ve got a thing in a bit…

ds:353:40:Dialogue Text.source: No worries, you tell me when you’re ready!

ds:354:96:Dialogue Text.source: Yeah! Whattya think about those runes?

ds:354:97:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]It’s mysterious! Adventerous! I feel like I’m in a book or something!

ds:355:25:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Though I feel like it was a bit more dull before…

ds:355:27:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m just glad those runes stopped glowing!

ds:355:33:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]That’s great to hear! Let us know if you need anything dear~!

ds:356:138:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]You should let us dress you up sometime.

ds:356:141:Dialogue Text.source: I’m not so sure about that one…

ds:356:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]What did you make of those ruins?

ds:356:155:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I put it as an accent for my hat! It was spectacular while it was glowing!

ds:356:156:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]But when the glowing stopped, I ditched it.

ds:356:161:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]C’mon Vi, you’re telling me you wouldn’t do the same?

ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.source: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*
ds:357:149:Dialogue Text.target: *Camera pans to canvas, showing new painting*

ds:357:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Those glowing glyphs gave me some wicked cool ideas.

ds:357:151:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I’ll paint a series on it…

ds:357:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]About the stones? I mean, it’s pretty damn weird…

ds:357:154:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But uh, nothing bad seems to have happened.

ds:357:158:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Things sure are pickin’ up with you around.

ds:357:160:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah! Somethin’ tells me things are just getting started!

ds:358:162:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Rascal! Gosh, I’ve been learning a lot of stuff here!

ds:358:163:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? Do you know what’s going on?

ds:358:164:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’ve cross referenced a few things, and this has indeed happened before.

ds:358:165:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But it was a VERY long time ago. Which is great news!

ds:358:171:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’d love to chat Rascal, but I’ve got a lot of stuff to look through.

ds:359:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Now that stuff’s gettin’ a lil weird in the forest, training is more important than ever!

ds:359:213:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve got a new routine set up if you’d like to give it a shot!

ds:359:214:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]It’s the Novice level! Whattya say, mate??

ds:359:216:Dialogue Text.source: Actually let’s do the Training Routine.

ds:359:217:Dialogue Text.source: On second thought, I’ll pass for now.

ds:359:219:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oooh, ya wanna try the Novice Track, eh? Great!

ds:359:220:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So this one’s gonna be a lil different, mate, so pay attention!

ds:359:221:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]First, this one will be a bit longer. I’ve got a bit of a routine set up for ya!

ds:359:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Second, unlike the training, I’ll be going a lot harder are on ya, mate. So keep your eyes peeled!!

ds:359:223:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]That said, I don’t want to hurt you, so i’ll stop the training if you get hit more than 3 times!

ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.source: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*
ds:359:230:Dialogue Text.target: *First time you complete it, after Dustin comes crashing down with lightning*

ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.source: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*
ds:359:231:Dialogue Text.target: *Gameplay stops, music fades out, Cutscene mode and Rascal exclaims*

ds:359:233:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Eh heh… Yeah sorry about that, mate…

ds:359:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Haha, let’s just keep that between us, eh?

ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.source: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*
ds:359:238:Dialogue Text.target: *fail out, sleep sprite fade to black go back to game world. probably autostop koreo*

ds:359:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I got ya pretty good there, eh?

ds:359:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]You’ll have to be quicker next time!

ds:359:243:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But eh, sorry if I went a lil hard!

ds:359:245:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Let me know if you want to try again!

ds:363:663:Dialogue Text.source: But I definitely want to do this again…

ds:390:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Critters had no choice but to band together. They would exchange and share provisions, huddle for warmth, and share in eachother’s company.

ds:390:277:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But they knew it wouldn’t last, they knew they needed help.

ds:390:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]So each night, when the weather was the most still, the critters would ring their bells for hope that anyone would hear it.

ds:390:279:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Day after day, new critters would show up, share in the warmth and comfort others could provide, and night after night, they would ring their bells.

ds:390:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Weeks went by. Until finally, on the 18th night, a heavy sound rung out from the skies.

ds:390:281:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The familiar sound of a bell, but this one was much larger… It grew louder and louder. It was coming closer!

ds:390:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]On the 19th night, a great falcon was spotted in the distance.

ds:390:283:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]The bird carried a tremendous bell, ringing out far into the night.

ds:390:284:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]The critters calls were heard, they were answered!

ds:390:285:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]The Falcon circled overhead, ringing out their giant bell. And the critters joined in with their own chorus of bells!

ds:390:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Within hours, a rescue team came barreling after the falcon, providing food and water to all.

ds:390:287:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Thus, The Blessing of the Bells became a widespread story. A necessity for winter survival back in the day.

ds:390:289:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I go flying around with a BIG OLE BELL ringing across the lands!

ds:390:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Critters down below will join me ringing out their own bells as I pass by. It’s a wonderful time!

ds:390:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]It really is! It’s a magical time, and I’m super grateful I can be a part of it!

ds:390:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Did Scarlett tell you why this is a holiday at all? Where it all started?

ds:390:295:Dialogue Text.source: She said I should hear it from you.

ds:390:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Well The Blessing of the Bells has become much more superficial these days.

ds:390:298:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Gift giving, partying, decorations, friends and family, y’know how it goes…

ds:390:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]But it actually started in much darker times…

ds:390:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Long ago, the Winters were very harsh, and times were much tougher. Provisions were harder to come by, and larger communities like ours were quite scarce.

ds:390:301:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Snowy seasons were quite dangerous. If a family didn’t prepare, there were dire consequences…

ds:390:302:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]One terrible Winter, the winds blew harder than ever, the snow was relentless, the temperatures were unbearable.

ds:390:306:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh it’s a wonderful time! Lots of the critters here get into the spirit of things.

ds:390:307:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I hope you’ll join us for the next one!

ds:390:308:Dialogue Text.source:
I’d like to!
Can you tell me more about it?

ds:390:310:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s a month long celebration, where critters bundle up, decorate their surroundings, share gifts and meals!

ds:390:311:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]We close out each night of celebration with a ringing of a bell!

ds:390:312:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Then do the whole thing over the next day!

ds:390:314:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]It is! And that’s not even the best part!

ds:390:315:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]The very last day, yours truly finishes the entire celebration with "The Blessing!"

ds:390:318:Dialogue Text.source:
I’ve heard you know a thing or two
about The Blessing of the Bells?

ds:391:260:Dialogue Text.source:
I was wondering if you could
tell me about The Blessing of the Bells

ds:391:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh? Isn’t it a little early to be thinking of that?

ds:391:262:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s the middle of Summer after all…

ds:391:263:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Er wait, have you celebrated The Blessing before?

ds:391:264:Dialogue Text.source:
I’ve just learned about it.
Penny said you could tell me more.

ds:391:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah yes, you’ve come to the right gator!

ds:391:266:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Knowing Penny, she’s likely told you the cultural and historical significance already?

ds:391:269:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I’m assuming she told you to come to me to hear about The Saint?

ds:391:271:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Haha, I bet she wasn’t too keen on telling you that part…

ds:391:273:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Indeed… See cultural holidays will vastly change over generations.

ds:391:274:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It can be hard to tell what stemmed from legitimacy, and what was added for fun.

ds:391:275:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]To Penny’s credit, I can’t say I’ve seen records of "The Saint" being involved with The Blessing…

ds:391:276:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But as a child, this aspect was a favorite of mine for the festivities. I’m definitely guilty of perpetuating this nonsense, but it’s so fun!

ds:391:278:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Right - so, you’re generally familiar with the origins of The Blessing of the Bells?

ds:391:280:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well it’s been said that there was a mysterious critter going around providing small boons and gifts to the young.

ds:391:281:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Likely to keep their mind off of such perilous times.

ds:391:282:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Again, no official records of that happening - But the myth became tradition!

ds:391:283:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s customary to give each other gifts during this holiday, but it’s also customary to give some gifts in total anonymity, thus continuing on the spirit of "The Saint".

ds:391:286:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And there’s no secret that I try to play that role during our celebrations…

ds:391:287:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Believe me, it’s QUITE TRICKY for a fella like me to provide gifts without being noticed…

ds:391:290:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Even I receive some of these anonymous gifts… Like truly anonymous.

ds:391:291:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]See, it’s always easy to tell when a critter here is "trying" to be secretive.

ds:391:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But I’ll occasionally get a truly mysterious gift, and try as I might, no one seems to know where it comes from.

ds:391:293:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]All the critters know I’m supposed to be "The Saint" - so they often think I’m messing with them.

ds:391:294:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]But I swear to you, I’ve no idea who keeps gifting me things during the festivities.

ds:391:295:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Obviously it’s gotta be a critter here, and really I’m just happy to see the spirit of The Saint living on.

ds:391:297:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Anyways, will you be joining us for this year’s Blessing?

ds:391:298:Dialogue Text.source: I hope so! It sounds amazing!

ds:391:299:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It really is a special time here for us.

ds:391:300:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I know I don’t speak for myself when I say we’d love to have you!

ds:391:301:Dialogue Text.source: Thanks for telling me about all of this!

ds:392:261:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I was gonna pick up some veggies for a stew…

ds:392:264:Dialogue Text.source: I only ever see like, 3 things for sale.

ds:392:265:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah he’s got stuff in the back. No idea why there’s only ever 3 things on display here…

ds:408:62:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith knows damn well that this weather is nothing for him.

ds:408:63:Dialogue Text.source: Not to mention her cloak would be like a napkin to a dragon.

ds:408:65:Dialogue Text.source: Regardless, she humors him and gives him the cloak.

ds:408:66:Dialogue Text.source: This took him off guard, he thought for sure she souldn’t go through with it.

ds:408:67:Dialogue Text.source: But she did, and now he had to figure out how to tie this tiny thing around his neck.

ds:408:69:Dialogue Text.source: And despite it being a joke at first…

ds:408:70:Dialogue Text.source: It’s the little gestures that really get to him.

ds:408:73:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Aw! It’s the little genuine connections that do it!

ds:408:76:Dialogue Text.source: They’ve been here for a while.

ds:408:77:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Heh, yeah we wanted to see what you guys were up to!

ds:408:78:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Yeah sorry! I didn’t mean to interrupt! I just got lost in the cuteness…

ds:408:7:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’ve always wanted to be a part of a book club though!

ds:408:80:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh, it’s just a scene and some characters from a book!

ds:408:81:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal asked if I had any favorite books, and I was telling him about this one.

ds:408:83:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Yeah! Haha, I wasn’t expecting an audience heh!

ds:408:84:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]How about… <pause>I turn up the heat and tell ya guys about one of the scenes between the two?

ds:408:85:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Blimey, between a Dragon and a Wolf?

ds:408:88:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Now close your eyes and imagine for a second…

ds:408:8:Dialogue Text.source: Ah! Maybe we can make one here!

ds:408:91:Dialogue Text.source: Let’s see… Ah! Here we are…

ds:408:94:Dialogue Text.source: Lyllith let out a gasp. Her body was trembling. Every part of her was on fire, she wanted MORE.

ds:408:95:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn’s fingers slipped further inside her. He was gentle, but his strength and size was apparent.

ds:408:96:Dialogue Text.source: As his fingers explored her, he gently nipped and licked at her neck.

ds:408:97:Dialogue Text.source: "Nnf ahh~!" Lyllith moaned. She’d taken on many dragons before… But not like this…

ds:408:99:Dialogue Text.source: Volkyn’s muzzle met hers. Lyllith’s mouth was ajar, panting. He took that as an invitation.

ds:409:723:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=8]Hey Mel, would you please get me the cookies?

ds:409:728:Dialogue Text.source: *Charlotte hides under a blanket or something.*
ds:409:728:Dialogue Text.target: *Charlotte hides under a blanket or something.*

ds:409:730:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]M-Melody isn’t here right now, p-please come back later!

ds:409:731:Dialogue Text.source: *Fade to black, remove Charlotte laying down, replace with Charlotte sitting by the kitchen*
ds:409:731:Dialogue Text.target: *Fade to black, remove Charlotte laying down, replace with Charlotte sitting by the kitchen*

ds:409:733:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Hey Rascal… I know we just met, but could I ask a favor?

ds:409:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I haven’t seen Charlotte this excited in a while.

ds:409:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Would you mind doing whatever she asks for a bit?

ds:409:738:Dialogue Text.source: I was planning on it anyways!

ds:409:740:Dialogue Text.source:
Errr, sorry I didn’t mean to scare you.
I’m just a visitor.

ds:409:742:Dialogue Text.source:
Yeah, I came to the forest a few days ago.
I’m new here.

ds:409:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I see… Do you just walk into critter’s houses where you come from?

ds:409:744:Dialogue Text.source: Well you don’t exactly have a door…

ds:409:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wonderful! I’ll make it up to you somehow!

ds:409:747:Dialogue Text.source:
Honestly I’m surprised you haven’t heard of me.
I thought gossip traveled fast in the forest…

ds:409:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah, we’re kinda secluded up here… And I tend to keep to myself most of the times…

ds:409:751:Dialogue Text.source: Um, I can leave if you want.

ds:409:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh, no that’s ok. You just really caught me off guard.

ds:409:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Nice to meet you. I see you aren’t from around here.

ds:409:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Red Panda, right? The first time I’ve seen one!

ds:409:757:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s right! I’ve come to experience
"the love!" of the forest!

ds:409:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]O-Oh! Heh… Well that’s much more Melody’s department…

ds:409:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And you can take all the time you need until you’re ready, darling.

ds:409:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But really though, any day now would be great…

ds:409:771:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I see you’ve met a new friend?

ds:409:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I had to make sure you weren’t trying to hurt my poor little Charlotte.

ds:409:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]As I’m sure you guessed, I’m Melody!

ds:409:781:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We weren’t expecting guests, or I would have had tea prepared…

ds:409:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Now, what can we do for you?

ds:409:783:Dialogue Text.source: Do you happen to have Finley’s Stuff?

ds:409:785:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Oh yes, we put his stuff in a box.

ds:409:786:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]We thought he’d come by to pick it up but…

ds:409:787:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I guess we pushed him too far…

ds:409:789:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yeaaaah we definitely took him for granted.

ds:409:790:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]See Rascal, we were a bit of a handful as roommates…

ds:409:794:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]But we definitely could’ve tried a little harder…

ds:409:796:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… You know, that gives me an idea!

ds:40:253:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Hey there, Rascal! I was just out wandering!

ds:410:204:Dialogue Text.source: Oh? Looks like some adult titles?

ds:410:205:Dialogue Text.source: Ok this whole bottom section is erotic novels…

ds:410:207:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=9]Oh uh! Melody is pretty picky about critters going into her room.

ds:410:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=10]She doesn’t even let me in there that often…

ds:411:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Can’t wait to cook with you sometime!

ds:411:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Always happy to see you around here!

ds:412:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Rascal, darling. I haven’t seen Charlotte this excited in a while.

ds:412:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Would you mind doing whatever she asks for a bit?

ds:412:749:Dialogue Text.source: I was planning on it anyways!

ds:412:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wonderful! I’ll make it up to you somehow!

ds:412:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I can’t wait to see you go next!

ds:413:130:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Alright Rascal… I’ve got a plan, but I’ll need your help.

ds:413:132:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]So, I’ve been meaning to meet the critters of the forest, right?

ds:413:134:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And we also need to patch up our relationship with Finley, right?

ds:413:136:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I think I have a way to do both!

ds:413:137:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But I need you to help break the ice, what do you say?

ds:413:141:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]No Rascal, I’m asking for your help. Please be serious!

ds:413:144:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]See, I like to bake, and I’m pretty good if I do say so myself.

ds:413:145:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]But I’m not good at meeting new folks…

ds:413:146:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]And the last time I tried, I scared them off by accident…

ds:413:147:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m willing and really wanting to put in the work, but if you could help me out, I’d be very grateful!

ds:413:148:Dialogue Text.source: Why not have Melody do it?

ds:413:149:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]She’s out going and great with people for sure… But we’re both basically strangers to the rest of the critters…

ds:413:150:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]This would just make things smoother, if you don’t mind!

ds:413:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Great! Well first I need to get baking.

ds:413:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

ds:413:154:Dialogue Text.source:
Of course I’ll help out!
Though I might charge a cookie tax…

ds:413:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Once they are done, I’ll let you know!

ds:413:718:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]So why not break the ice with some extra special "friendship cookies"!

ds:414:715:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]These cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!

ds:414:717:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh, and here’s that special one for Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!

ds:414:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!

ds:414:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Give that special one to Finley… Make sure he knows it’s from us!

ds:414:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Rascal, the cookies are piping fresh and ready to go!

ds:414:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Be sure to give some to all the critters!

ds:415:717:Dialogue Text.source: This one’s from a new friend!

ds:415:719:Dialogue Text.source: Nope! Have ya met Charlotte and Melody?

ds:415:720:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah! Yes the bear and fox up in the caves, right?

ds:415:721:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’ve seen them here and there, but very seldomely.

ds:415:726:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Umm… Can I take a few more?

ds:416:737:Dialogue Text.source: Actually, I have something for ya!

ds:416:740:Dialogue Text.source: It is! I hope you like cookies!

ds:416:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Thanks Rascal! This is very nice of you!

ds:416:743:Dialogue Text.source:
Actually they’re from Charlotte and Melody!
I’m just the delivery boy.

ds:416:745:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanna be more active
with the critters down here.

ds:416:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’m a bit familiar with them, but obviously they’re a little large to use my services.

ds:416:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]And frankly, no one really goes up there - but there is a perch! That’s a part of my route!

ds:416:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]Hmm, I don’t think I have a spare bell though… I really have to make more…

ds:416:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=11]They might have a spare one up there…

ds:416:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I mean, it’s not like they use the one I gave them!

ds:417:737:Dialogue Text.source: Have you met Melody and Charlotte?

ds:417:738:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]The polar bear and the fox gal, right?

ds:417:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But I have wanted to meet em!

ds:417:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]I’ve got a thing for big ladies, mate!

ds:417:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]See lil’ guys like myself can uh… get in pretty deep if ya know what I’m sayin.

ds:417:746:Dialogue Text.source: I think I catch your drift.

ds:417:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Anywho a guy can dream! For now, toss one of those cookies over!

ds:417:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I gotta load up on carbs anyways, so this is perfect!

ds:418:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]If it isn’t Rascal! How are you dear?

ds:418:737:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m good! And I’ve got
cookies for the two of you!

ds:418:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Hold on love! I’ll make sure they aren’t poison…

ds:418:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Of course, I’ll need to test yours as well…

ds:418:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]If these are poison, it’ll just be the end of me!

ds:418:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Also, how dare you insinuate our lil’ Rascal would poison us!

ds:418:746:Dialogue Text.source: Actually they aren’t made by me!

ds:418:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ll have to ask her for the recipe!

ds:418:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Mm, yes! It’s that depth of savory, but the hint of salty…

ds:418:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I’m going to tell her you’re making these jokes.

ds:418:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]… Maybe there’s rabbit in these cookies…

ds:418:761:Dialogue Text.source: Do you two know Charlotte and Melody?

ds:418:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Ah yes! The critters up North. They don’t frequent these parts too often.

ds:418:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I’ve always wanted to make a trek up there and meet them. But it’s awfully cold up there!

ds:418:767:Dialogue Text.source: Claire and Violet knitted me a sweater.

ds:418:769:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Oh! I bet you’re absolutely adorable in it!

ds:418:773:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Funny thing about those critters up north…

ds:418:774:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I haven’t met them, but I was out scavenging, and the bear… Charlotte, was it?

ds:418:775:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]She’s awfully quiet for how large she is!

ds:418:776:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]She managed to sneak up on me, and I ended up having a bit of a fright!

ds:418:777:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I didn’t quite realize who it was, so I bolted.

ds:418:778:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It dawned on me later, but I never got the chance to mention it! It’d be a laugh now!

ds:418:780:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]That’s right! You had quite a fright that day.

ds:418:782:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]It’s not every day you see a bear in the woods!

ds:418:788:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… Or, did she poison these cookies to finish the job?!

ds:419:736:Dialogue Text.source:
I’m delivering cookies!
Here ya go!

ds:419:739:Dialogue Text.source: This seems like a good problem to have.

ds:419:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I can’t possibly eat this much! It’ll take a week to finish it!

ds:419:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Break me off a piece. You can have the rest of mine.

ds:419:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Who made these? A frickin’ bear or something?

ds:419:744:Dialogue Text.source:
Yes actually! Have you
met Charlotte and Melody?

ds:419:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I haven’t! But I have heard about them.

ds:419:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Wow, and they can bake? Oh these are great too!

ds:419:749:Dialogue Text.source: Yep! They want to meet everyone.

ds:419:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well they’re off to a great start! Gosh these cookies are killer!

ds:41:200:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Perfect timing! I’ve been bored as hell.

ds:41:208:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]I see you’ve also met our boy, Ollie!

ds:41:214:Dialogue Text.source: Claire/Violet both (Only have the dialogue once, with both of their portraits)
ds:41:214:Dialogue Text.target: Claire/Violet both (Only have the dialogue once, with both of their portraits)

ds:41:222:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Haha, we’re fuck buddies. He’s always so bashful about it. It’s adorable.

ds:41:224:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Claire, You’re gonna scare this new guy off.

ds:41:226:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]C’mon Vi, You can smell it, this boy’s been up to a lot already!

ds:41:228:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Of course I can smell it, I’m just being polite.

ds:41:230:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We’ll just see what the new guy thinks.

ds:41:231:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]How about it new guy, are we scaring you?

ds:41:236:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oh come on Vi, he’s clearly messing with us.

ds:41:239:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s what I’m talking about! Look at him, this guy’s GOT it.

ds:41:241:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Say… You came at a pretty good time.

ds:41:242:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Maybe you can help us figure something out…

ds:41:247:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Haha, I don’t think so Vi, he’s already agreed to help us.

ds:41:252:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Which one of us would make you cum faster?

ds:41:254:Dialogue Text.source: Only one way to find out…

ds:41:292:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Whew! I’m beat. Thanks for being the judge there.

ds:420:736:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Huh? For me? Aren’t I the one who handles deliveries?

ds:420:741:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Charlotte and Melody?

ds:420:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Yeah, the fox and bear up north?

ds:420:743:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s right! They wanna be more
friendly and active with you guys.

ds:420:744:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’d be great! I’d love to see them more often!

ds:420:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Mmm~ These cookies rock too! Top tier cookies if I do say so myself.

ds:420:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Remember that camera I was fiddling with?

ds:420:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well it’s good to go! Let me know if you meet any critters that might wanna do some modeling!

ds:420:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Maybe Charlotte or Melody would be interested!

ds:420:753:Dialogue Text.source:
Isn’t that a little too forward
for new critters?

ds:420:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Folks don’t live around these parts and expect paid dinner and three dates!

ds:420:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I’m sure you’ve realized that by now!

ds:420:758:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Atta’ boy! And gimme another cookie before you leave!

ds:421:740:Dialogue Text.source: Do you know Charlotte and Melody?

ds:421:742:Dialogue Text.source:
They live up north, but they haven’t
really come down here that often.

ds:421:744:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanted to be neighborly!
Break the ice, so to speak.

ds:421:745:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oooh I shoulda done that! Everyone likes food!

ds:421:746:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]Gosh, it’s a little hard for someone like me to cook though…

ds:421:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]They seem like nice critters! I’ll be looking forward to meeting them!

ds:421:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oh… And… Can I have another cookie?

ds:422:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]… Hmm, no. I smell other critters on him… Melody?

ds:422:743:Dialogue Text.source: Yep, that’s right! You know them?

ds:422:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]We don’t really know her roommate, Charlotte. But we DO know her baking!

ds:422:748:Dialogue Text.source:
They wanna get to know
the critters around here.

ds:422:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]That’s great! We’ve been trying to egg them on to do it for a while.

ds:422:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]But Finley used to be roommates with them. We’d all hang every so often.

ds:422:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’ll also join Melody on her excursions!

ds:422:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Those were usually to other parts of the forest though. Not in this neighborhood.

ds:422:760:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]We’d go looking for random one night flings.

ds:422:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]You should join us if we ever go again!

ds:423:738:Dialogue Text.source:
And Charlotte made cookies!
This one’s for you specifically.

ds:423:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh, man, I do miss her baking…

ds:423:741:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Aw look, it says "We’re Sorry" heh… Looks like they’re trying, eh?

ds:423:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Oooh, and look here, they cleaned all my belongings!

ds:423:747:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Well, not all critters have the same standards I suppose!

ds:423:748:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]It was a weird lesson to learn, and we never really… concluded it too well together.

ds:423:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]In the heat of the moment, it was very aggravating, but now I can see that not all critters are compatible in terms of living situations.

ds:423:752:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]On the surface, it was mainly that they were really messy…

ds:423:753:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Clothes and trash on the floor. Kitchen a total mess.

ds:423:754:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]I was the one cleaning most of it, and I have hooves! Not an easy task!

ds:423:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Melody would even borrow my gear and forget to clean it! Yuck!

ds:423:756:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]But what it really seemed to be, was a lack of respect. To me and their living space.

ds:423:757:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=5]I mean, you were up there, right? You probably saw the mess.

ds:423:761:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=6]Really?? And the clothes on the floor?

ds:423:762:Dialogue Text.source:
There was a clothing rack.
Didn’t see much on the floor.

ds:423:763:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]And Charlottes books? Those had to be around right?

ds:423:764:Dialogue Text.source:
Nope, on a book case.
Alphabetized I believe.

ds:423:765:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Hah. Of course. They get their act together once I’m gone.

ds:423:766:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah well, at least they seemed to have taken my complaints seriously…

ds:423:768:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]Well. It’s not very becoming of me to let these petty things stack up and ruin some friendships. I should go talk to them.

ds:424:734:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Oooh! Now what do we have here?

ds:424:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Oh! Gosh, I probably shouldn’t… I’ve eaten a lot of sweets lately…

ds:424:738:Dialogue Text.source: Oh but these are friendship cookies!

ds:424:739:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Oh I see! Well then of course there’s room for a friendship cookie!

ds:424:740:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I didn’t peg you as a baker!

ds:424:741:Dialogue Text.source:
That’s because I’m not! These are
from the critters in the mountains!

ds:424:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=3]Ah what was their names… Medley… Charlene?

ds:424:749:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]Ah yes! That’s right. I did some work for them a bit ago.

ds:424:750:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Some of my finer work! And it was my first time working in ice too! Tricky stuff!

ds:424:751:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=2]I wonder if that’s still holding up…

ds:424:754:Dialogue Text.source: Ok, I gotta go deliver more cookies.

ds:424:755:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Sounds good! Pass my compliments to the chef!

ds:424:761:Dialogue Text.source:
Didn’t you say something about
having too many sweets lately?

ds:424:763:Dialogue Text.source:
Well there’s always room
for Friendship Cookies!

ds:424:764:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Haha that’s right! I’ll be sure to savor this one!

ds:425:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.

ds:425:153:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll track down Finley’s stuff.

ds:426:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Rascal, darling! Give me a few minutes and I’ll gather up Finley’s stuff.

ds:427:152:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=1]Here you go, darling! This box should be everything Finley left up here.

ds:428:737:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Yes, we took you for granted and were just terrible roommates!

ds:428:742:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=7]Now now, I also have my fair share of the blame. I’ve never been good at confronting these things…

ds:428:743:Dialogue Text.source: [pic=4]I should have tried to communicate more before things blew up.
